rationale: CIEN has dropped approximately 10.5% from prior close with no available news catalyst to explain the move, making directional conviction very low — the sell-off could represent a news-driven flush with mean-reversion potential, or continued distribution, and without knowing the driver I cannot assign meaningful edge to either side. Price is near the session low at only 11.9% of range with some stabilization in the last two candles, but it remains deeply below both the 5-min VWAP ($320.88) and session VWAP ($352.87), offering no structural long setup, while shorting into a 10%+ already-realized decline with 94 minutes to close adds adverse-fill and gap-risk exposure I cannot quantify. Given the already negative daily P&L and absence of a clear mechanical edge, skipping preserves capital.
